//: mirbadllm-agent on an Apple Silicon Mac (Phase 1; deploy/agent/macos, README.md there; plan docs/macos/implementation-plan.md). install-agent.sh installs it as /Library/Application Support/mirbadllm-agent/agent.json (root:_mirbadllm 0640) with NodeId and the two roots filled in (--node-id, --models-root, --cache-root), only when the file does not exist yet; the LaunchDaemon com.mirbadllm.agent runs the agent as the hidden user _mirbadllm, which owns the state directory and both roots. No Docker on a Mac (Docker:Enabled false, ManageContainers false): models run as native processes from the Executables catalogue on loopback ports (Executables stays [] here: install-agent.sh fills it when it installs the llama.cpp release pinned in llama-cpp.lock.json into /usr/local/lib/mirbadllm-agent/runtimes/llama.cpp/<tag>/ with Metal, unless --no-llama; update-llama re-provisions it; MLX later), so *Root and *HostPath are the same directories and UseContainerNetwork is false. MemoryModel Unified: CPU and GPU share one pool; Metal lets the GPU keep about two thirds of RAM resident (5.3 GiB on an 8 GiB Mac), hence the small MemoryReserveGiB. No systemd units and no backup mount; launchd jobs (Ollama, LM Studio, ComfyUI) go through the macOS hostd (Phase 4, M10): 'install-agent.sh install-hostd' installs the root LaunchDaemon com.mirbadllm.hostd and sets ManageLaunchdJobs and HostdExpected to true (HostdSocket is its socket). Enroll once with 'install-agent.sh install --node-id ... --enroll-url ... --ca-hash ...' and MIRBADLLM_JOIN_TOKEN or the prompt (the macOS command "Add node" shows); no BootstrapDirectory here. NodeId must match the join command: lower-case letters, digits and '-', at most 40. The master dials Port (9443) on this Mac: if the macOS application firewall is on, allow the agent binary (install-agent.sh --allow-firewall). DockerEndpoint and the image settings are unused while Docker is off.
